digest.overview: 今日仅有 1 条新闻，聚焦 OLED 设备厂商 Avaco 的季度业绩与订单交付节奏。Avaco 连续第三个季度亏损，但公司预计随着 OLED 设备开始出货，第四季度将出现明显盈利改善。该条信息反映出 OLED 上游设备环节的收入确认周期对厂商短期业绩波动影响显著。

news.title_zh: Avaco 连续第三个季度亏损，但随着 OLED 设备开始出货，预计第四季度表现强劲
news.summary_zh: 韩国 OLED 设备制造商 Avaco 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，营收为 473 亿韩元（约 3480 万美元），同比下降 6%，营业亏损 340 万美元，为连续第三个季度亏损。公司表示已于 10 月底开始向客户出货主要 OLED 设备，并预计 2026 年第四季度将实现大幅盈利改善。
news.why: Avaco 的设备出货与收入确认节奏表明，OLED 上游设备订单的交付延迟会拖累厂商短期业绩，但后续出货有望带动其业绩回升，对 OLED 设备供应链的交付周期管理具有参考意义。

items.title: Avaco posts its third straight quarterly loss, but expects a strong Q4 as OLED equipment shipments begin
items.abstract: Korea-based OLED equipment maker Avaco reported its financial results for Q3 2026, with revenues of 47.3 billion won (about $34.8 million USD), down 6% from Q3 2025, and an operating loss of $3.4 million USD. This is Avaco's third straight quarterly loss - but the company expects a large profit swing in Q4 2026, as it started shipping major OLED equipment to its customers at the end of October. Avaco recognizes revenue only when it ships its equipment, and delays in the manufacturing and shipment schedules of its major tools kept most of this year's order volume out of its Q1-Q3 results. Adjustments to delivery timelines and revenue recognition for major projects also weighed on its first-half results.
